Specification of Diagnostic Event Manager
AUTOSAR CP R20-11
Note:
DemDebounceCounterStorage
is not supported for time based debouncing.
[SWS_Dem_00675]
⌈
If the configuration parameter
DemDebounceCounterStorage
is set to True, the Dem module shall re-store the current value of the internal
debounce
counter
during each startup (latest in
Dem_Init
).
⌋
(RS_Diag_04124)
Note: BSW events using non-volatile storage of the internal
debounce counter
can-
not be reported before
Dem_Init
, because the value needs first to be restored.
[SWS_Dem_00676]
⌈
If development error detection is enabled and
Dem_-
SetEventStatus
or
Dem_ResetEventDebounceStatus
is called before
Dem_-
Init
or after
Dem_Shutdown
for events which have
DemDebounceCounterStor-
age
set to True, the Dem module shall set the error code
DEM_E_WRONG_CONDITION
.
⌋
(RS_Diag_04124)
[SWS_Dem_CONSTR_06151] Dependency on DemCounterBasedFdcThreshold-
StorageValue
⌈
The configuration parameter
DemCounterBasedFdcThreshold-
StorageValue
shall only be present if
DemFreezeFrameRecordTrigger
is set to
DEM_TRIGGER_ON_FDC_THRESHOLD
or
DemExtendedDataRecordTrigger
is set
to
DEM_TRIGGER_ON_FDC_THRESHOLD
or
DemEventMemoryEntryStorageTrig-
ger
is set to
DEM_TRIGGER_ON_FDC_THRESHOLD
.

7.7.3.2 Time based debounce algorithm
[SWS_Dem_00527]
⌈
The Dem module shall provide a configuration parameter
DemDebounceTimeBasedSupport
(refer to
DemGeneral
) to enable or disable the
Dem-internal time based debouncing.
